title: Unilever Future Leaders Programme 2027 - Customer Development

reasons.love: Commercial rotation in FMCG / e-commerce, one of his preferred tracks.
reasons.good_at: F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company; F26 shows Excel reporting.
reasons.needs: Structured rotations and a published path to manager at a growing regional company.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. THB 50,000-65,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Good commercial fit with a clear growth path.
jd_text: Unilever Thailand is hiring for Unilever Future Leaders Programme 2027 - Customer Development in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
